text.description_html:
First Impressions FII-515C-US32D Satin Stainless Steel Contemporary Flush Door Pull.

This very contemporary Stainless Steel Flush Pull was designed and manufactured by First Impressions. The face plate is made from very heavy 1/4" thick high grade solid stainless steel to last a lifetime. Made in the USA.

Concealed mounting screws for a very clean contemporary look. Make an up-to-date decor statement with these designer choice contemporary flush door pulls!

This very Contemporary Style flush door pull can be used in many applications such as:

  • Sliding and Pocket Doors
  • Metal framed glass doors, such as on showers
  • Pantry and Cabinet doors
  • Just about anywhere a Flush with the Door face door pull is needed.

Specifications for First Impressions 515C-US32D Contemporary Flush Pull

  • Total Length: 6-3/4"
  • Total Width: 2-3/4"
  • Max Depth : 7/8"
  • Face Plate Thickness: 1/4"
  • Opening Length: 4-11/16"
  • Opening Width: 1-9/16"
  • Face Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Packaged Complete with Mounting Hardware
  • Satin Stainless Steel Finish

*Sold individually. Limited supply.
